findings.detail: The 191,249,826 residual equals Level 1 money market and fixed income mutual funds included in total investments but outside the private-markets holdings universe.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the filing total and companyfacts anchor agree at 2,292,614,325, while the extracted private-markets holdings sum is 2,101,364,499. The 191,249,826 difference is fully localized in raw source to Level 1 investments: 13,143,788 Money Market Mutual Funds plus 178,106,038 Fixed Income Mutual Funds. Those non-private Level 1 funds are included in the companyfacts total-investments anchor, so the conservation check is using an over-broad anchor for the private-markets holdings data rather than proving a holdings extraction defect.
